readback.en: For every number field $K$, every index type $I$ (not assumed finite), and every $x:I\to K$, define $\operatorname{infPart}(x)=\prod_{w\mid\infty}(\sup_{i\in I}w(x_i))^{m_w}\in\mathbb R$. Here $w$ ranges over infinite places of $K$, and $m_w$ is their multiplicity. No nonzero or boundedness hypothesis is imposed on $x$; the supremum is the total conditional real supremum, rather than a maximum assumed to exist.
readback.zh-Hans: 对任意数域 $K$、任意指标类型 $I$（不假定有限）及 $x:I\to K$，定义 $\operatorname{infPart}(x)=\prod_{w\mid\infty}(\sup_{i\in I}w(x_i))^{m_w}\in\mathbb R$，其中 $w$ 遍历 $K$ 的无限处，$m_w$ 是无限处重数。未对 $x$ 施加非零或有界假设；上确界使用实数中对全部输入有定义的条件完备上确界，不假定最大值存在。
readback.ja: 任意の数体 $K$、有限とは限らない添字型 $I$、$x:I\to K$ に対して $\operatorname{infPart}(x)=\prod_{w\mid\infty}(\sup_{i\in I}w(x_i))^{m_w}\in\mathbb R$ と定める。$w$ は $K$ の無限素点を走り、$m_w$ はその重複度である。$x$ に非零性や有界性を仮定せず、上限には実数の条件付き完備構造で全入力に定義された演算を用い、最大値の存在を仮定しない。

readback.en: For every number field $K$, arbitrary index type $I$, and $x:I\to K$, define $\operatorname{finPart}(x)=\prod^{\mathrm f}_{v\nmid\infty}\sup_{i\in I}v(x_i)\in\mathbb R$. Here $\prod^{\mathrm f}$ is the total finite-support product (the product of nonidentity terms when that support is finite, and $1$ otherwise); no finiteness, boundedness, or nonzero assumption on $x$ is made.
readback.zh-Hans: 对任意数域 $K$、任意指标类型 $I$ 及 $x:I\to K$，定义 $\operatorname{finPart}(x)=\prod^{\mathrm f}_{v\nmid\infty}\sup_{i\in I}v(x_i)\in\mathbb R$。其中 $\prod^{\mathrm f}$ 为对全部输入有定义的有限支撑乘积：非单位值的支撑有限时取其乘积，否则取 $1$；未假定指标有限、坐标有界或元组非零。
readback.ja: 任意の数体 $K$、添字型 $I$、$x:I\to K$ に対し、$\operatorname{finPart}(x)=\prod^{\mathrm f}_{v\nmid\infty}\sup_{i\in I}v(x_i)\in\mathbb R$ と定める。$\prod^{\mathrm f}$ は単位元と異なる値の台が有限ならその積、そうでなければ $1$ とする全域的な有限台積である。添字の有限性、座標の有界性、組の非零性はいずれも仮定しない。

readback.en: For a number field $F$ and a tuple $z:I\to F$, write $H_F(z)$ for the relative multiplicative height, equal to $1$ for the zero tuple and otherwise to $\prod_{w\mid\infty}(\sup_i w(z_i))^{m_w}\prod^{\mathrm f}_{v\nmid\infty}\sup_i v(z_i)$, and write $A_F(z)=\log H_F(z)$; here $w,v$ are the normalized infinite and finite absolute values and $m_w$ is the infinite-place multiplicity. All suprema and the finite-support product use the total real-valued operations in the code. For a number field $K$, an arbitrary index type $I$, and a nonzero tuple $x:I\to K$, $H_K(x)=\operatorname{infPart}(x)\operatorname{finPart}(x)$, where the two factors are respectively the infinite-place product $\prod_w(\sup_i w(x_i))^{m_w}$ and the finite-place finite-support product $\prod^{\mathrm f}_v\sup_i v(x_i)$. The index type is not assumed finite.
readback.zh-Hans: 对数域 $F$ 和元组 $z:I\to F$，用 $H_F(z)$ 表示相对乘法高度：零元组的值为 $1$，其余情形为 $\prod_{w\mid\infty}(\sup_i w(z_i))^{m_w}\prod^{\mathrm f}_{v\nmid\infty}\sup_i v(z_i)$；记 $A_F(z)=\log H_F(z)$。其中 $w,v$ 分别为归一化的无限处、有限处绝对值，$m_w$ 为无限处的重数。上确界及有限支撑乘积均采用代码中对所有输入有定义的实数运算。 对数域 $K$、任意指标类型 $I$ 及非零元组 $x:I\to K$，有 $H_K(x)=\operatorname{infPart}(x)\operatorname{finPart}(x)$，两因子分别为无限处乘积 $\prod_w(\sup_i w(x_i))^{m_w}$ 和有限处有限支撑乘积 $\prod^{\mathrm f}_v\sup_i v(x_i)$。不假定 $I$ 有限。
readback.ja: 数体 $F$ と組 $z:I\to F$ に対し、相対的乗法的高さ $H_F(z)$ は零の組では $1$、それ以外では $\prod_{w\mid\infty}(\sup_i w(z_i))^{m_w}\prod^{\mathrm f}_{v\nmid\infty}\sup_i v(z_i)$ であり、$A_F(z)=\log H_F(z)$ と書く。$w,v$ は正規化された無限素点と有限素点の絶対値、$m_w$ は無限素点の重複度である。上限と有限台積には、コードで全入力に対して定義された実数値演算を用いる。 数体 $K$、任意の添字型 $I$、非零の組 $x:I\to K$ に対し、$H_K(x)=\operatorname{infPart}(x)\operatorname{finPart}(x)$ である。二つの因子はそれぞれ無限素点での積 $\prod_w(\sup_i w(x_i))^{m_w}$ と有限素点での有限台積 $\prod^{\mathrm f}_v\sup_i v(x_i)$ であり、$I$ の有限性は仮定しない。

lemma prod_pow_mult_eq_prod_embeddings {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (g : InfinitePlace K → M) :
    ∏ w : InfinitePlace K, g w ^ w.mult = ∏ φ : K →+* ℂ, g (mk φ)
declarations.raw_declaration:
lemma prod_pow_mult_eq_prod_embeddings {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (g : InfinitePlace K → M) :
    ∏ w : InfinitePlace K, g w ^ w.mult = ∏ φ : K →+* ℂ, g (mk φ) := by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.prod_fiberwise Finset.univ mk (fun φ => g (mk φ))]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_
  have : ∀ φ ∈ ({φ | mk φ = w} : Finset (K →+* ℂ)), g (mk φ) = g w := fun φ hφ => by
    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hφ).2]
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl this, Finset.prod_const, card_filter_mk_eq]

readback.en: For a number field $K$, any commutative monoid $M$, and any $g$ from the infinite places of $K$ to $M$, $\prod_w g(w)^{m_w}=\prod_{\phi:K\hookrightarrow\mathbb C}g(\operatorname{mk}(\phi))$, where the right product runs over all unital ring embeddings into $\mathbb C$ and $\operatorname{mk}(\phi)$ is the infinite place associated with $\phi$.

readback.ja: 数体 $K$、任意の可換モノイド $M$、$K$ の無限素点から $M$ への任意の写像 $g$ に対し、$\prod_w g(w)^{m_w}=\prod_{\phi:K\hookrightarrow\mathbb C}g(\operatorname{mk}(\phi))$ である。右辺は $\mathbb C$ へのすべての単位的環埋め込みを走り、$\operatorname{mk}(\phi)$ は対応する無限素点、$m_w$ はその重複度である。

lemma card_filter_comp_algebraMap_eq (φ : k →+* ℂ) :
    #{ψ : K →+* ℂ | ψ.comp (algebraMap k K) = φ} = finrank k K
declarations.raw_declaration:
lemma card_filter_comp_algebraMap_eq (φ : k →+* ℂ) :
    #{ψ : K →+* ℂ | ψ.comp (algebraMap k K) = φ} = finrank k K := by
  classical
  letI : Algebra k ℂ := φ.toAlgebra
  rw [← AlgHom.card k K ℂ, ← Finset.card_univ]
  symm
  refine Finset.card_nbij (fun σ => (σ : K →+* ℂ)) (fun σ _ => ?_)
    (fun σ _ τ _ h => AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective h) (fun ψ hψ => ?_)
  · simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    ext x
    simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
  · simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hψ
    refine ⟨⟨ψ, fun x => ?_⟩, by simp, rfl⟩
    simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, ← hψ]

readback.en: For number fields $k,K$ with a specified $k$-algebra structure on $K$ and every unital ring embedding $\phi:k\hookrightarrow\mathbb C$, the number of all unital ring embeddings $\psi:K\hookrightarrow\mathbb C$ satisfying $\psi\circ a=\phi$ is $[K:k]$, where $a:k\to K$ is the specified algebra map.
readback.zh-Hans: 设数域 $K$ 带指定的 $k$-代数结构，$k$ 也是数域，记对应代数映射为 $a:k\to K$。对每个保单位环嵌入 $\phi:k\hookrightarrow\mathbb C$，满足 $\psi\circ a=\phi$ 的全部保单位环嵌入 $\psi:K\hookrightarrow\mathbb C$ 的个数等于 $[K:k]$。
readback.ja: 数体 $k,K$ と $K$ 上の指定された $k$-代数構造を取り、その代数写像を $a:k\to K$ とする。任意の単位的環埋め込み $\phi:k\hookrightarrow\mathbb C$ に対して、$\psi\circ a=\phi$ を満たすすべての単位的環埋め込み $\psi:K\hookrightarrow\mathbb C$ の個数は $[K:k]$ である。

lemma prod_comp_algebraMap {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (g : (k →+* ℂ) → M) :
    ∏ ψ : K →+* ℂ, g (ψ.comp (algebraMap k K)) = (∏ φ : k →+* ℂ, g φ) ^ finrank k K
declarations.raw_declaration:
lemma prod_comp_algebraMap {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (g : (k →+* ℂ) → M) :
    ∏ ψ : K →+* ℂ, g (ψ.comp (algebraMap k K)) = (∏ φ : k →+* ℂ, g φ) ^ finrank k K := by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.prod_fiberwise Finset.univ (fun ψ : K →+* ℂ => ψ.comp (algebraMap k K)),
    ← Finset.prod_pow]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun φ _ => ?_
  have : ∀ ψ ∈ ({ψ | ψ.comp (algebraMap k K) = φ} : Finset (K →+* ℂ)),
      g (ψ.comp (algebraMap k K)) = g φ := fun ψ hψ => by rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hψ).2]
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl this, Finset.prod_const, card_filter_comp_algebraMap_eq]

declarations.raw_declaration:
lemma infPart_algebraMap {ι : Type*} (y : ι → k) :
    infPart (fun i => algebraMap k K (y i)) = infPart y ^ finrank k K := by
  simp only [infPart]
  rw [prod_pow_mult_eq_prod_embeddings (fun w : InfinitePlace K => ⨆ i, w (algebraMap k K (y i))),
    prod_pow_mult_eq_prod_embeddings (fun w : InfinitePlace k => ⨆ i, w (y i)),
    ← prod_comp_algebraMap (fun φ : k →+* ℂ => ⨆ i, (mk φ) (y i))]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun ψ _ => ?_
  rw [← comap_mk]
  rfl

    (y : ι → L) : logHeight (fun i => φ (y i)) = Height.logHeight y / finrank ℚ L := by
  set x : ι → Qbar := fun i => φ (y i) with hx
  set M : IntermediateField ℚ Qbar := φ.toRatAlgHom.fieldRange
  let g : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] M := AlgEquiv.ofInjectiveField φ.toRatAlgHom
  have : FiniteDimensional ℚ M := g.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  have hle : fieldOf x ≤ M := by
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y i, rfl⟩
  have h1 := AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PolarAbsolute.logHeight_comp_ringHom_div_finrank
    (IntermediateField.inclusion hle).toRingHom (coords x)
  have h2 := AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PolarAbsolute.logHeight_comp_ringHom_div_finrank g.toRingEquiv.toRingHom y
  have hcomp : (fun i => (IntermediateField.inclusion hle).toRingHom (coords x i)) =
      fun i => g.toRingEquiv.toRingHom (y i) := by
    ext i
    rfl
  rw [logHeight, ← h1, hcomp, h2]

theorem logHeight_smul (x : ι → Qbar) {c : Qbar} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    logHeight (c • x) = logHeight x
declarations.raw_declaration:
theorem logHeight_smul (x : ι → Qbar) {c : Qbar} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    logHeight (c • x) = logHeight x := by
  set F := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (insert c (Set.range x))
  have hcF : c ∈ F := IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hxF : ∀ i, x i ∈ F := fun i =>
    IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  have hcxF : ∀ i, (c • x) i ∈ F := fun i => F.mul_mem hcF (hxF i)
  rw [logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem F hxF, logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem F hcxF]
  have hc' : (⟨c, hcF⟩ : F) ≠ 0 := fun h => hc (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  rw [← Height.logHeight_smul_eq_logHeight (fun i => (⟨x i, hxF i⟩ : F)) hc']
  rfl

theorem logHeight_comp_le (f : κ → ι) (x : ι → Qbar) :
    logHeight (x ∘ f) ≤ logHeight x := by

theorem logHeight_mul_table {x : ι → Qbar} (hx : x ≠ 0) {y : κ → Qbar} (hy : y ≠ 0) :

declarations.raw_declaration:
theorem logHeight_mul_table {x : ι → Qbar} (hx : x ≠ 0) {y : κ → Qbar} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    logHeight (fun p : ι × κ => x p.1 * y p.2) = logHeight x + logHeight y := by
  set F := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range x ∪ Set.range y)
  have hxF : ∀ i, x i ∈ F := fun i =>
    IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  have hyF : ∀ j, y j ∈ F := fun j =>
    IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Or.inr ⟨j, rfl⟩)
  have hxyF : ∀ p : ι × κ, x p.1 * y p.2 ∈ F := fun p => F.mul_mem (hxF p.1) (hyF p.2)
  rw [logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem F hxF, logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem F hyF,
    logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem F hxyF, ← add_div]
  have hx' : (fun i => (⟨x i, hxF i⟩ : F)) ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hx
    exact Function.ne_iff.mpr ⟨i, fun h => hi (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩
  have hy' : (fun j => (⟨y j, hyF j⟩ : F)) ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hy
    exact Function.ne_iff.mpr ⟨j, fun h => hj (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩
  rw [← Height.logHeight_fun_mul_eq hx' hy']
  rfl

theorem tupleHeight_eq_of_mul {s : ι → K} (hs : ∃ i, s i ≠ 0) (x : QbarPoint K) (g : K)
    (hmem : ∀ j, s j * g ∈ x.P.1) (hne : ∃ j, x.eval (s j * g) (hmem j) ≠ 0) :
    tupleHeight s x = logHeight (fun j => x.eval (s j * g) (hmem j))
declarations.raw_declaration:
theorem tupleHeight_eq_of_mul {s : ι → K} (hs : ∃ i, s i ≠ 0) (x : QbarPoint K) (g : K)
    (hmem : ∀ j, s j * g ∈ x.P.1) (hne : ∃ j, x.eval (s j * g) (hmem j) ≠ 0) :
    tupleHeight s x = logHeight (fun j => x.eval (s j * g) (hmem j)) := by
  rw [tupleHeight_def hs]
  set i₀ := normIdx x.P s hs with hi₀
  have hs₀ : s i₀ ≠ 0 := normIdx_ne_zero hs
  have hg : g ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hne
    apply hj
    have : x.eval (s j * 0) (hmem j) = x.eval 0 x.P.1.zero_mem :=
      x.noncritical_eval_congr (by rw [mul_zero]) _
    rw [this, x.noncritical_eval_zero]
  -- `u = s_{i₀} g` is a unit at `x`
  set u := s i₀ * g with hu
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hs₀ hg
  have hfac : ∀ j, s j * g = s j / s i₀ * u := fun j => by
    rw [hu]
    field_simp
  have hord : x.P.ord u = 0 := by
    have h0 : 0 ≤ x.P.ord u := x.P.ord_nonneg_of_mem (hmem i₀)
    by_contra hne0
    have hpos : 0 < x.P.ord u := lt_of_le_of_ne h0 (Ne.symm hne0)
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hne
    apply hj
    rw [x.polar_eval_eq_zero_iff']
    rcases eq_or_ne (s j) 0 with hsj | hsj
    · left
      rw [hsj, zero_mul]
    · right
      rw [hfac j, x.P.ord_mul (div_ne_zero hsj hs₀) hu0]
      have := x.P.ord_nonneg_of_mem (div_normIdx_mem (P := x.P) hs j)
      linarith
  have humem : u ∈ x.P.1 := hmem i₀
  have hueval : x.eval u humem ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, x.noncritical_eval_zero_iff humem hu0]
    omega
  have : (fun j => x.eval (s j * g) (hmem j)) = x.eval u humem • evalTuple x s hs := by
    funext j
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, evalTuple]
    rw [← x.noncritical_eval_mul humem (div_normIdx_mem hs j)]
    exact x.noncritical_eval_congr (by rw [hfac j, mul_comm]) _
  rw [this, logHeight_smul _ hueval]

A point $x$ consists of a place $P_x$ and an arbitrary unital ring embedding $\sigma_x:\kappa(P_x)	o\overline{\mathbb Q}$ of its entire residue field. For $f\in O_{P_x}$, $E_x(f)=\sigma_x(f mod\mathfrak m_{P_x})$; its point field is the full image $\sigma_x(\kappa(P_x))$, not the field generated by a selected value. Quantification over $x$ includes every such embedding and no affine restriction. For a number field $F$ and a tuple $z:I	o F$, write $H_F(z)$ for the relative multiplicative height, equal to $1$ for the zero tuple and otherwise to $\prod_{w\mid\infty}(\sup_i w(z_i))^{m_w}\prod^{\mathrm f}_{v
mid\infty}\sup_i v(z_i)$, and write $A_F(z)=\log H_F(z)$; here $w,v$ are the normalized infinite and finite absolute values and $m_w$ is the infinite-place multiplicity. For a finite-indexed tuple $z:I	o\overline{\mathbb Q}$, put $F_z=\mathbb Q(z_i\mid i\in I)$ and $h(z)=A_{F_z}((z_i)_{i\in I})/[F_z:\mathbb Q]$, with the coordinates viewed in $F_z$. e0$, let $n(P,s)$ be the choice made in the definition of an index minimizing $\operatorname{ord}_P(s_i)$ among nonzero entries; no uniqueness is asserted. theorem tupleHeight_smul {s : ι → K} (x : QbarPoint K) {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    tupleHeight (fun j => c * s j) x = tupleHeight s x
declarations.raw_declaration:
theorem tupleHeight_smul {s : ι → K} (x : QbarPoint K) {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    tupleHeight (fun j => c * s j) x = tupleHeight s x := by
  by_cases hs : ∃ i, s i ≠ 0
  · have hcs : ∃ i, c * s i ≠ 0 := by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hs
      exact ⟨i, mul_ne_zero hc hi⟩
    set i₀ := normIdx x.P s hs
    have hs₀ : s i₀ ≠ 0 := normIdx_ne_zero hs
    set g := (c * s i₀)⁻¹ with hg
    have hcg : ∀ j, c * s j * g = s j / s i₀ := fun j => by
      rw [hg]
      field_simp
    have hmem : ∀ j, c * s j * g ∈ x.P.1 := fun j => by
      rw [hcg j]
      exact div_normIdx_mem hs j
    have hne : ∃ j, x.eval (c * s j * g) (hmem j) ≠ 0 := by
      refine ⟨i₀, ?_⟩
      have : c * s i₀ * g = 1 := by
        rw [hg]
        exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero hc hs₀)
      rw [x.noncritical_eval_congr this, x.noncritical_eval_one]
      exact one_ne_zero
    rw [tupleHeight_eq_of_mul hcs x g hmem hne, tupleHeight_def hs]
    congr 1
    funext j
    exact x.noncritical_eval_congr (hcg j) _
  · have hcs : ¬ ∃ i, c * s i ≠ 0 := by
      push Not at hs ⊢
      intro i
      rw [hs i, mul_zero]
    simp [tupleHeight, hs, hcs]

theorem tupleHeight_mul {s : ι → K} {t : κ → K} (hs : ∃ i, s i ≠ 0) (ht : ∃ j, t j ≠ 0)
    (x : QbarPoint K) :
    tupleHeight (fun p : ι × κ => s p.1 * t p.2) x = tupleHeight s x + tupleHeight t x
declarations.raw_declaration:
theorem tupleHeight_mul {s : ι → K} {t : κ → K} (hs : ∃ i, s i ≠ 0) (ht : ∃ j, t j ≠ 0)
    (x : QbarPoint K) :
    tupleHeight (fun p : ι × κ => s p.1 * t p.2) x = tupleHeight s x + tupleHeight t x := by
  set i₀ := normIdx x.P s hs
  set j₀ := normIdx x.P t ht
  have hs₀ : s i₀ ≠ 0 := normIdx_ne_zero hs
  have ht₀ : t j₀ ≠ 0 := normIdx_ne_zero ht
  have hst : ∃ p : ι × κ, s p.1 * t p.2 ≠ 0 := ⟨(i₀, j₀), mul_ne_zero hs₀ ht₀⟩
  set g := (s i₀ * t j₀)⁻¹ with hg
  have hfac : ∀ p : ι × κ, s p.1 * t p.2 * g = s p.1 / s i₀ * (t p.2 / t j₀) := fun p => by
    rw [hg]
    field_simp
  have hmem : ∀ p : ι × κ, s p.1 * t p.2 * g ∈ x.P.1 := fun p => by
    rw [hfac p]
    exact mul_mem (div_normIdx_mem hs p.1) (div_normIdx_mem ht p.2)
  have hval : ∀ p : ι × κ, x.eval (s p.1 * t p.2 * g) (hmem p) =
      evalTuple x s hs p.1 * evalTuple x t ht p.2 := fun p => by
    rw [x.noncritical_eval_congr (hfac p), x.noncritical_eval_mul (div_normIdx_mem hs p.1) (div_normIdx_mem ht p.2)]
    rfl
  have hne : ∃ p, x.eval (s p.1 * t p.2 * g) (hmem p) ≠ 0 := by
    refine ⟨(i₀, j₀), ?_⟩
    rw [hval, evalTuple_normIdx x hs, evalTuple_normIdx x ht, one_mul]
    exact one_ne_zero
  rw [tupleHeight_eq_of_mul hst x g hmem hne, tupleHeight_def hs, tupleHeight_def ht]
  simp only [hval]
  exact logHeight_mul_table (evalTuple_ne_zero x hs) (evalTuple_ne_zero x ht)

theorem tupleHeight_pair_one_of_mem (x : QbarPoint K) {f : K} (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) :
    tupleHeight ![1, f] x = logHeight ![1, x.eval f hf] := by
  have hs : ∃ i, (![1, f] : Fin 2 → K) i ≠ 0 := ⟨0, by simp⟩
  have hmem : ∀ j, (![1, f] : Fin 2 → K) j * 1 ∈ x.P.1 := fun j => by
    fin_cases j
    · simpa using x.P.1.one_mem
    · simpa using hf
  have hne : ∃ j, x.eval ((![1, f] : Fin 2 → K) j * 1) (hmem j) ≠ 0 := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rw [x.noncritical_eval_congr (by simp : (![1, f] : Fin 2 → K) 0 * 1 = 1), x.noncritical_eval_one]
    exact one_ne_zero
  rw [tupleHeight_eq_of_mul hs x 1 hmem hne]
  congr 1
  funext j
  fin_cases j
  · exact (x.noncritical_eval_congr (by simp) _).trans x.noncritical_eval_one
  · exact x.noncritical_eval_congr (by simp) _

theorem tupleHeight_pair_one_of_notMem (x : QbarPoint K) {f : K} (hf : f ∉ x.P.1) :
    tupleHeight ![1, f] x = 0
declarations.raw_declaration:
theorem tupleHeight_pair_one_of_notMem (x : QbarPoint K) {f : K} (hf : f ∉ x.P.1) :
    tupleHeight ![1, f] x = 0 := by
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := fun h => hf (h ▸ x.P.1.zero_mem)
  have hfi : f⁻¹ ∈ x.P.1 := (x.P.mem_or_inv_mem f).resolve_left hf
  have hs : ∃ i, (![1, f] : Fin 2 → K) i ≠ 0 := ⟨0, by simp⟩
  have hmem : ∀ j, (![1, f] : Fin 2 → K) j * f⁻¹ ∈ x.P.1 := fun j => by
    fin_cases j
    · simpa using hfi
    · simpa [hf0] using x.P.1.one_mem
  have hne : ∃ j, x.eval ((![1, f] : Fin 2 → K) j * f⁻¹) (hmem j) ≠ 0 := by
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    rw [x.noncritical_eval_congr (by simp [hf0] : (![1, f] : Fin 2 → K) 1 * f⁻¹ = 1), x.noncritical_eval_one]
    exact one_ne_zero
  rw [tupleHeight_eq_of_mul hs x f⁻¹ hmem hne]
  have h0 : x.eval ((![1, f] : Fin 2 → K) 0 * f⁻¹) (hmem 0) = 0 := by
    rw [x.polar_eval_eq_zero_iff']
    right
    have : (![1, f] : Fin 2 → K) 0 * f⁻¹ = f⁻¹ := by simp
    rw [this, x.P.ord_inv]
    have := (x.P.ord_neg_iff).mpr hf
    omega
  have h1 : x.eval ((![1, f] : Fin 2 → K) 1 * f⁻¹) (hmem 1) = 1 := by
    rw [x.noncritical_eval_congr (by simp [hf0] : (![1, f] : Fin 2 → K) 1 * f⁻¹ = 1), x.noncritical_eval_one]
  have : (fun j => x.eval ((![1, f] : Fin 2 → K) j * f⁻¹) (hmem j)) = ![0, 1] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · exact h0
    · exact h1
  rw [this]
  have hswap : (![0, 1] : Fin 2 → Qbar) = ![1, 0] ∘ Equiv.swap 0 1 := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  rw [hswap, logHeight_comp_equiv, logHeight_one_zero]

theorem minOrd_mul {s : ι → K} {t : κ → K} (hs : ∃ i, s i ≠ 0) (ht : ∃ j, t j ≠ 0)
    (P : Place K) : minOrd P (fun p : ι × κ => s p.1 * t p.2) = minOrd P s + minOrd P t
declarations.raw_declaration:
theorem minOrd_mul {s : ι → K} {t : κ → K} (hs : ∃ i, s i ≠ 0) (ht : ∃ j, t j ≠ 0)
    (P : Place K) : minOrd P (fun p : ι × κ => s p.1 * t p.2) = minOrd P s + minOrd P t := by
  have hst : ∃ p : ι × κ, s p.1 * t p.2 ≠ 0 :=
    ⟨(normIdx P s hs, normIdx P t ht), mul_ne_zero (normIdx_ne_zero hs) (normIdx_ne_zero ht)⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · have := minOrd_le (P := P) hst (j := (normIdx P s hs, normIdx P t ht))
      (mul_ne_zero (normIdx_ne_zero hs) (normIdx_ne_zero ht))
    rw [P.ord_mul (normIdx_ne_zero hs) (normIdx_ne_zero ht), ← minOrd_eq hs,
      ← minOrd_eq ht] at this
    exact this
  · rw [minOrd_eq hst]
    set p := normIdx P (fun p : ι × κ => s p.1 * t p.2) hst
    have hp : s p.1 * t p.2 ≠ 0 := normIdx_ne_zero hst
    rw [P.ord_mul (left_ne_zero_of_mul hp) (right_ne_zero_of_mul hp)]
    exact add_le_add (minOrd_le hs (left_ne_zero_of_mul hp))
      (minOrd_le ht (right_ne_zero_of_mul hp))

  have hrs : ∃ i, r * s i ≠ 0 := ⟨normIdx P s hs, mul_ne_zero hr (normIdx_ne_zero hs)⟩

  · rw [minOrd_eq hrs]

    rw [P.ord_mul hr (right_ne_zero_of_mul hi)]

class IsCurveField (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] : Prop where
  exists_finite : ∃ t : K, Transcendental ℚ t ∧ FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮t⟯ K

abbrev Place (K : Type*) [Field K] : Type _ :=
  {O : ValuationSubring K // O ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ q : ℚ, (q : K) ∈ O}

abbrev ResidueField (P : Place K) : Type _ := IsLocalRing.ResidueField P.1

noncomputable def residue (P : Place K) : P.1 →+* P.ResidueField :=
  IsLocalRing.residue P.1

structure QbarPoint (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] where
  P : Place K
  σ : P.ResidueField →+* Qbar

noncomputable def eval (x : QbarPoint K) (f : K) (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) : Qbar :=
  x.σ (x.P.residue ⟨f, hf⟩)

noncomputable def fieldOf (x : QbarPoint K) : IntermediateField ℚ Qbar :=
  x.σ.toRatAlgHom.fieldRange

noncomputable def valuation (P : Place K) : Valuation K ℤᵐ⁰ :=
  (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1).valuation K

/-- The order of vanishing `ord_P f ∈ ℤ` of `f` at the place `P` (junk value `ord_P 0 = 0`). -/
noncomputable def ord (P : Place K) (f : K) : ℤ := -WithZero.log (P.valuation f)
